channel.title: Receipts
channel.description: AI and agent-economy news. Every number links to its source.

item.title: Anthropic expected to price its IPO Wednesday at $70–78 a share
item.description:
825M shares on Nasdaq as ANT. About $61B raised and $1.2T fully diluted at the midpoint.

  • $61B raised at the $74 midpoint, on 825 million shares
  • $1.2T fully diluted value at the midpoint, excluding $111B of convertible debt
  • $26B bought privately by seven companies, including Nvidia, Google and Microsoft
  • $16.96B Q3 revenue, up 47% on Q2, with a $567M operating loss
  • $895B in purchase commitments, mostly compute

Sources:

  1. Renaissance Capital: IPO terms and midpoint value (Press)
  2. LetsDataScience: Amended S-1 and the private placement (Press)
  3. StockAnalysis: Q3 figures from the filing (Press)
  4. Dealroom: Nine-month revenue and commitments (Press)
  5. INDmoney: No trading date in the announcement (Press)

Confidence: SEC filing

item.title: Nvidia posts a $115.8B quarter five days after Jensen Huang quit
item.description:
$7.8B above its own guide. Next quarter's margin guide falls to 71–72%.

  • $115.8B revenue, up 103% from a year ago and $7.8B above its $108B guide
  • $107.6B from data centers
  • $130B next-quarter guide, ±3%, including an extra week; gross margin 71–72%, down from 74.9%
  • Nov 12 Huang resigned after a board investigation into reports he was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO.

Sources:

  1. Nvidia: Q3 fiscal 2027 results and outlook (Company)
  2. FourWeekMBA: The $108B guide and Q2 revenue (Press)
  3. SEC: Form 8-K on the resignation (Filing)
  4. Mixed News: The board investigation (Press)
  5. TheStreet: The FT report and the earnings call (Press)
  6. CIO Dive: Year-ago quarter: $57.0B (Press)

Confidence: Company + SEC

item.title: OpenAI raised $15B at a $1.25T valuation, CNBC reports
item.description:
Half the $30B it went out for. OpenAI hasn't confirmed it.

  • $15B raised, half the $30B OpenAI first sought
  • $1.25T valuation, below the $1.4T it pitched and about 47% above March's $852B
  • $11B first close on Nov 6, according to Bloomberg

Sources:

  1. Stocktwits: CNBC's David Faber on the raise (Press)
  2. LetsDataScience: Bloomberg on the $11B first close (Press)
  3. ValueAdd VC: Pre- or post-money, unresolved (Press)
  4. Crypto Briefing: Anthropic's $965B May round (Press)

Confidence: Press report

item.title: AI agents still barely buy anything
item.description:
Every on-chain agent payment last quarter added up to $3.7M. Shopify sold $119.1B.

  • $3.7M in on-chain agent payments in Q3, across 68.3M transactions, about 5¢ each (Allium)
  • Airbnb CEO says agent bookings are at "very, very low numbers"
  • Mastercard working with OpenAI on agent payments, says volumes aren't significant yet but grow weekly
  • 3.3x growth in Shopify orders from AI search in Q3

Sources:

  1. Semafor: Airbnb on agent bookings (excerpt) (Press)
  2. The Paypers: Mastercard's comments (Press)
  3. Fireblocks: Allium's count of agent payments (Data)
  4. Stellagent: Shopify Q3 results (Press)

Confidence: Press + data

item.title: Anthropic, Google and Nvidia move AI agents onto company hardware
item.description:
Self-hosted agent services, private sandboxes and agent monitoring built into chips.

  • Anthropic lets companies self-host the full Claude Managed Agents service in a private beta, routing model calls through the Claude API, Bedrock, Google Cloud, Foundry or their own gateway
  • Google added self-hosted sandboxes to Gemini API agents on Nov 11
  • Nvidia announced Sentry, software on BlueField-4 chips that monitors agent behavior in hardware

Sources:

  1. Anthropic: Self-hosted Managed Agents (Company)
  2. AI TLDR: Model routes and audit export (Press)
  3. The New Stack: License terms (Press)
  4. FourWeekMBA: Pricing, and Google's sandboxes (Press)
  5. Nvidia: Sentry and OpenShell (Company)

Confidence: Company

item.title: Google ships Gemini 4 Carbon and a cheaper Hydrogen
item.description:
Carbon tops the Artificial Analysis index at 59. Its price doubles after Nov 30.

  • 59 Carbon's score on the Artificial Analysis index, first of 52 models
  • $2 / $10 Carbon's price per million input and output tokens through Nov 30, then $4 / $20
  • $1.50 / $7.50 Hydrogen, released Nov 12 for everyday coding and agent work

  2. Jetstream: Pricing after Nov 30 (Press)
  3. TeamoRouter: Hydrogen's price (Press)
  4. SmartScope: Benchmarks and rank (Press)

item.title: Alibaba announces Qwen4 and Moonshot ships Kimi K3.1 Pro
item.description:
Open models trail closed ones by a few index points. Reliability is the bigger gap.

  • Qwen4 announced Nov 11 with a Qwen4-Max preview; MiniMax open-sourced a 4K image model
  • 60 vs 63.1 best open and best closed model on the Artificial Analysis index, late August
  • 13.3% of Toloka's agent tasks Kimi K3 (2.8T parameters) completed reliably across five runs

Sources:

  1. AF.net: Distill Intelligence briefing (Press)
  2. AI2Work: Open vs closed on the index (Press)
  3. Toloka: Agent reliability test (Data)

Confidence: Press report

item.title: Nobody has confirmed that OpenAI cut off Cursor on Nov 12
item.description:
OpenAI set the date after SpaceX bought Cursor. Its models were about 5% of Cursor's traffic.

  • Nov 12 OpenAI's proposed end date for model supply, citing Musk companies' record of breaking contracts
  • 5% of Cursor traffic used OpenAI models, per Cursor's CEO

  2. The Decoder: OpenAI's contract argument (Press)
  3. Hyrax: OpenAI's share of Cursor traffic (Press)

item.title: Big checks for fal, Shield AI, Mirendil and LangChain
item.description:
Inference, defense autonomy and agent tooling drew the largest rounds.

  • $1.3B fal, which runs model inference, at a $16B valuation (Bloomberg)
  • $1B Shield AI's Series H at $28.8B, part of $2.5B to buy Echodyne for $5.3B
  • $1B Mirendil, agents for science and engineering research
  • $300M LangChain, agent management

Sources:

  1. FourWeekMBA: fal and Shield AI rounds (Press)
  2. Jawlah: Mirendil and LangChain rounds (Press)

Confidence: Press report

item.title: AI is 2026's top stated reason for US layoffs, and the share swings wildly
item.description:
Employers blamed AI for 40% of cuts in May and under 3% in October.

  • 22% of announced US job cuts this year cited AI, about 121,000 jobs (Challenger)
  • 28,000 jobs a month lost in finance and information payrolls while total US jobs grow (Bloomberg, BLS data)
  • 4.1% US unemployment in October

Sources:

  1. People Managing People: Challenger: AI in 22% of cuts (Data)
  2. HCA Magazine: 121,401 cuts attributed to AI (Press)
  3. TechJack: May and October shares (Press)
  4. AI Weekly: Bloomberg's read of BLS data (Press)
  5. Projet Celsius: Unemployment and hiring research (Data)

Confidence: Press + data
